title: Why Rainbows Form
topic: Refraction, internal reflection and dispersion of sunlight in raindrops (drafter demo, not narrated)

beats.narration: Every rainbow you see appears with the Sun at your back.
phrases: with the Sun at your back.

beats.narration: Sunlight enters a falling raindrop and bends as it slows down.
phrases: and bends as it slows down.

beats.narration: Each colour bends a different amount, so red and violet drift apart.
phrases: Each colour bends a different amount,
so red and violet drift apart.

beats.narration: The light reflects off the back of the drop and bends again leaving it.
phrases: The light reflects off the back of the drop

beats.narration: Millions of drops send each colour to your eye at about forty-two degrees.
phrases: Millions of drops send each colour to your eye

beats.narration: So no two people ever see exactly the same rainbow.
phrases: So no two people ever see
